blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Martin Romualdez, former House Speaker, on Wednesday, pleaded not guilty to plunder over an alleged P7.4 billion kickback during his arraignment at the Sandiganbayan Third Division. The plea was made by Romualdez in the anti-graft court via teleconferencing while at a facility at the New Quezon City Jail. The Leyte representative had been hospitalized for almost a week before being jailed.
